title: Maximum Population Year
summary: Given a 2D integer array logs with each entry [birth, death] representing the birth and death years of an individual, determine the earliest year with the highest population.
statement: Given a 2D integer array logs with each entry [birth, death] representing the birth and death years of an individual, determine the earliest year with the highest population. The population count for a year includes individuals born in that year or earlier, and those who died before the next year.
constraints: A person contributes in every year from birth inclusive to death exclusive.
Return the earliest year attaining maximum population.
reference_solution:
def earliest_maximum_population_year(logs):
 changes=[0]*101
 for birth,death in logs:changes[birth-1950]+=1;changes[death-1950]-=1
 population=best=0;answer=1950
 for offset,change in enumerate(changes):
  population+=change
  if population>best:best=population;answer=1950+offset
 return answer

hints: Birth adds one starting that year; death removes one starting that year.
Store those changes and scan their prefix sum.
Update the answer only when population strictly exceeds the previous maximum.
The prefix sum equals each year’s active half-open intervals, and strict improvement preserves the earliest year on ties.
